EGT_sensor_basis: Tt5 at the design point + 0.87 x (T04 limit - T04 design)
surge_detection: P3 falls > 5 % in 20 ms while N rises, or Kulite rms > 3x baseline: open bleed, cut to the decel line
flameout_detection: EGT drop > 100 K/s with fuel on: fuel off, auto-relight attempt above the windmill speed once

sensor_loss.P3: fuel from the N-only schedule (steady P3 at the ambient), accel line x0.8
sensor_loss.T04_or_EGT: accel line x0.8, T04 limit -50 K, no hot-day corrections
sensor_loss.IGV_position: vanes to the failure position, bleed interlock open
